text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 1, 2023) for 351 The West Mall.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 1, 2023) for 351 The West Mall, Folder Number: 23 180285 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 17, 2024. 2. Modified the Property Standards Order (August 1, 2023) for 351 The West Mall, Folder Number: 23 180285 PRS 00 IV, to include in the Required Action section for each Items 1 to 4, the following wording, "repair or replace guards and handrails as applicable".
